aiIntegrations.howtoTitle: How to get an API key

gemini: Open Google AI Studio at aistudio.google.com/apikey.
Sign in with the Google account that should own the key.
Create an API key (create or select a Google Cloud project if prompted).
Copy the key once and paste it into FEC-OS. Do not email, screenshot, or commit it.
Review Gemini API pricing and data terms on ai.google.dev before enabling production traffic.
groq: Open the Groq console at console.groq.com/keys.
Sign in to the Groq account that should own the key.
Create a new API key and copy it immediately.
Paste the key into FEC-OS. Groq’s API is OpenAI-compatible at api.groq.com/openai/v1.
Confirm current model availability and rate limits in the Groq console before relying on it.
openrouter: Sign in to your OpenRouter account.
Create a key and copy it. FEC-OS sends HTTP-Referer and X-Title automatically.
Paste the key into FEC-OS. You can select openrouter/free for no-cost experiments.
Free models and routing can change; confirm terms and availability on openrouter.ai before production use.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Companies, sites, ZKTeco devices, ADMS push, shifts and duplicate-window rules.
settings.admsHelp: The device can send users and punches over Wi‑Fi to FEC-OS without a PC, if Cloud Server / ADMS is on and the serial number is mapped below. USB file import still works. FEC-OS cannot poll TCP 4370 on the device from the hosted app.
settings.pushUrlHint: The device appends /iclock/cdata itself. Do not type a path. Full URL for operators: {{url}}
settings.stepWifi: Connect the SA40 to venue Wi‑Fi (COMM → WLAN) and confirm it can reach the internet.
settings.stepMenu: Open Menu → COMM. → Cloud Server Setting (or ADMS).
settings.stepDomain: Enable Domain Name: ON. Enable Proxy Server: OFF.
settings.stepHttps: HTTPS: ON if the firmware shows it. If the device has no HTTPS option, it cannot talk to Vercel directly — use USB import or a LAN agent.
settings.stepSn: Copy the SN from Menu → System Info into the device row below (e.g. map it to Inflatapark / ZKTeco Device 1).
settings.securityHint: Unknown serials are rejected. Set ADMS_COMM_KEY (and optionally ADMS_IP_ALLOWLIST) on the server so this is not a public punch injector. Enter the same comm key on the device if Cloud Server has Server Auth.
settings.name: Name
settings.duplicateWindow: Duplicate window {{seconds}}s. Absence requires a roster.
settings.snSaved: Serial mapped. The device can push once Cloud Server is set.
settings.fetchQueued: Fetch queued. The device will upload on its next poll (usually 1–2 minutes).
settings.fetchHelp: Queues a command for this terminal. FEC-OS cannot reach TCP 4370 from Vercel — the device must poll /iclock/getrequest.
settings.hourlyHelp: Hourly schedule: Vercel Cron calls /api/public/attendance-adms-poll every hour (needs CRON_SECRET and Vercel Pro for hourly; Hobby is daily). You can also click Fetch punches anytime.
